prompt.project_info: Create a cinematic full-body portrait of one original approved adult woman reclining on a large rumpled bed in a warm opulent bedroom.
prompt.main_subject: Original approved adult woman with natural warm skin, dark shoulder-length hair, calm confident direct gaze, and realistic skin texture. She wears a golden strapless satin gown with a reflective finish and soft folds cascading across the bed.
composition_elements: Eye-level full shot with subject reclining comfortably on a large rumpled bed.
Opulent room with warm wood, plush velvet, antique textiles, window, and soft teal shadow undertones.
Gown spreads across the bed with realistic satin draping and highlights.
Keep face, fabric sheen, bed texture, window, and quiet luxury hierarchy clear.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Natural warm window light with dim ambient fill, soft contrast, warm highlights on satin and skin, subtle teal shadows, atmospheric cinematic depth.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic 4:5 full-body portrait, 50mm lens at f/1.8, shallow depth of field, low ISO, slow ambient-light exposure, realistic satin, bedding, skin, and wood texture, subtle film grain, no text or watermark.

Use an opulent room with warm wood, plush velvet, antique textiles and window light, dim ambient fill, warm highlights, subtle teal undertones in the shadows, 50mm f/1.8, shallow depth of field, low ISO, soft atmospheric film grain, no text, no watermark.
